title: mentha sylvestris subsp. kotschyana
intro: Mentha sylvestris subsp. kotschyana, commonly known as Corsican mint, is a subspecies of perennial mint native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used for its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it effective in treating digestive issues, nausea, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Corsican mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The plant's therapeutic actions make it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of digestive issues and respiratory problems.
